title: Excellent experience in the heart of Barcelona & Spanish culinary culture
text:
Excellent experience in the heart of Barcelona & Spanish culinary culture. 

The story about jamón is a unique one and definitely a tasty one. Thought this experience I was able to learn everything about it while tasting an amazing Corpinat, cava.

The guide was friendly and the staff was knowledgeable.

Definitely recommend
author: matiasfQ6759CF

title: Ham and wine
text: Very nicely decorated place! The guide clarified all our doubts and was super friendly
author: AlfonsoFerrariGattas

title: If you want to know which jamón is the best, you need to come!
text: a very nice experience! We tasted five different types of jamón, from serrano to 100% bellota. We also tasted two different kinds of cava. The guide Mati was super nice, she explained everything to the detail and answered all of our questions. I would definitely recommend this experience.
author: anadQ2400TT

title: Highly recommended
text: Very good experience to really get to know the ham. Spectacular products
author: Q6934FYvaleriar

title: 10/10 plan with foodie friends
text: A very revealing experience. If you think you already know about hams, you are wrong. Spectacular plan to do with friends or family. Iván, a splendid master of ceremonies, Francisco, a wonderful ham carver, and Kadi's cava recommendations. 10/10
author: Z9585WZandreas

title: Lovely gastronomic team building experience!
text: Ivan, Kadi & Francisco are the dream team! So knowledgeable! We were here for a team building and it was so nice to see the team in a different light! Delicious cava and I got to learn a lot about why jamón is so important for Spain!  Thanks
author: johanal875

title: Jam History
text: Enormous experience, thanks to Ivan for the explanations that made us enjoy every moment and tasting. Highlighting Kadi and Francisco, enormous professionals. Recommended experience
